title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch
description: Used ToolSearch (×5 calls) to load deferred moeb MCP tool schemas during the spec session. No moeb equivalent exists. The start_spec output embeds a <functions> schema preload block per moeb.start-commands-tool-schema-preload.md, but the block was inaccessible because the start_spec response exceeded Claude Code MCP output limits and was persisted to a temp file. Agents must fall back to Claude Code's ToolSearch meta-tool to load schemas on demand.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a mechanism ensuring moeb tool schemas are accessible in-context even when start_spec output exceeds MCP response size limits. Possible approaches: (1) reduce the start_spec prompt size so the schema preload block fits within the response budget, (2) introduce a dedicated moeb tool that returns the JSON schema for a named tool, eliminating the need for ToolSearch.
